Every $c begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras. 

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.

Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.
94978-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94978-complete.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94978-complete.text: Well tamed, $N! You are becoming adept already.
94978-complete.title: Taming the Beast

94978-progress.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94978-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94978-progress.title: Taming the Beast

94979-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94979-accept.text:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler, now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the Galestrider, a proud, winged $c that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.
94979-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94979-progress.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94979-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94979-progress.title: Taming the Beast

95034-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
95034-accept.text:
I think you should know that it wasn't actually the Gnolls who attacked us on the road.

We were actually attacked by a giant, wolf-like creature that I now know as a "worgen". It dispatched our guards and came for me, but Banon threw himself in its path. I managed to get a spell off which startled the creature, causing it to flee, but Banon was already badly bitten. He insisted I leave him there but I refused.

We were limping back here when the gnolls found us. What came next was terrifying...
95034-accept.title: The Debt

95034-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
95034-complete.text:
So now you understand. At the very end of his strength after being pierced by a dozen gnoll blades, he reared up to strike me. In that final moment we locked eyes, and I could tell he still knew who he was and that he recognized me. He knew what was happening but he had no control over himself. That was the worst part.

If such a thing is possible, I will see the creature that doomed him dead so that it can never visit this horror on another living thing. I swear it upon the sky above.
95034-complete.title: The Debt

95036-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
95036-accept.text:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036-accept.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95036-complete.name: Trevan Rol
95036-complete.text: Now that we've got the materials we need, we just need a smith to craft the blade for us. I think I know just such a smith.
95036-complete.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95036-progress.name: Trevan Rol
95036-progress.text: Trust in the light to guide your blade. However, the light needs a good blade to guide.
95036-progress.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95041-accept.name: Jemma Quikswitch
95041-accept.text:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.

The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...
95041-accept.title: Data Hoarders

95042-accept.name: Ulric Frostveil
95042-accept.text:
A Forsaken paladin... here in Ashenvale? Amusing. 

So you seek a Kor Gem? Unsurprising as these are sometimes employed to empower magical weapons and implements by the paladins of the alliance. Why should a fallen paladin like you be any different?

If you truly desire one of the gems, then you must head north to the ruins known as Blackfathom Deeps. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, $c.
95042-accept.title: Seeking the Kor Gem

95042-complete.name: Ulric Frostveil
95042-complete.text:
You'll no doubt notice the corruption that permeates this gem. For your purposes, The magic needed to dispel the evil that the naga witches have infused into the gem is rather simple. A shame really, there's much one could learn from such powers.

I don't suppose you'd be willing to abandon whatever quest caused you seek this gem, and sell it to me instead? It could prove valuable to my... academic pursuits.
95042-complete.title: Seeking the Kor Gem

95042-progress.name: Ulric Frostveil
95042-progress.text: Kor gems can be used for great acts of evil. Far be it from me to judge if your intentions are pure. It matters not to me.
95042-progress.title: Seeking the Kor Gem

95065-accept.name: Gilbert Gray
95065-accept.text:
What a view... Best an old man can ask for.

The fish sure are bitin' now, though I'm down to my last bait. I don't suppose you have any spare fishing supplies on you? Of course not, forgive me. I get so excited at the thought of casting another line it didn't dawn on me I may be one of the few carrying supplies everywhere I go.

Would you be able to help refresh my stock? Catherine Leland has an assortment of fishing goods just west of the Trade District along the canals. Tell her old Gray sent you.
95065-accept.title: Fishin' Time

95111-accept.name: Trevan Rol
95111-accept.text:
In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.

I'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.
95111-accept.title: An Underrated Talent

95111-complete.name: Ott
95111-complete.text:
Interesting. I don't think anyone has ever asked me to actually carry out a custom commission for them. Mostly I just make humble, functional weapons in my own style. It's not much, but its honest work and I don't seek accolades or glory.

I'm happy to try, but why would you seek me for this? There are plenty of smiths in the Undercity that will take on custom jobs like this.
95111-complete.title: An Underrated Talent

95111-progress.name: Ott
95111-progress.text: Are you in need of a blade, $c?
95111-progress.title: An Underrated Talent

95125-accept.name: Ott
95125-accept.text:
These are some truly fine materials, $c. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.
95125-accept.title: Ott's Masterwork

95125-complete.name: Ott
95125-complete.text:
This blade is my finest work and I hope it serves you well in your travels. Thank you again for this opportunity.

Aka'Magosh, friend.
95125-complete.title: Ott's Masterwork

95126-accept.name: Ott
95126-accept.text: Here's the blade. You said that a $c named Trevan sent you? Please extend my thanks to him for this opportunity when you next see him. Go with honor, friend.
95126-accept.title: The Moonsilver Blade

95126-complete.name: Trevan Rol
95126-complete.text:
<Trevan takes the blade and inspects it carefully.> 

This will do nicely, $N. I knew that Ott had it in him to make something truly great.

The only thing left now is to kill that beast. Speak with Lumina when you are ready.
95126-complete.title: The Moonsilver Blade

95126-progress.name: Trevan Rol
95126-progress.text: Was Ott able to carry out the commission?
95126-progress.title: The Moonsilver Blade

95140-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
95140-accept.text:
I see that you have your weapon now, $c. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
95140-accept.title: Old Fire-Eye

95140-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
95140-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Banon may now rest in peace.

If you would be willing to allow it, I believe that I can impart some magic upon your freshly blooded blade to infuse it with a small measure of the magic of my people.

<Lumina Windsinger's eyes begin to glow a vibrant blue as she touches the bloodstained blade in your hand.>

It is done. It's a small thing, and I could scarcely improve such a magnificent blade. Regardless, I will pray to the winds that it serves you well, $c.
95140-complete.title: Old Fire-Eye

95140-progress.name: Lumina Windsinger
95140-progress.text: Is it done? Is the beast slain?
95140-progress.title: Old Fire-Eye

95204-accept.name: Unknown
95204-accept.text: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95204-accept.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95204-complete.name: Oran Snakewrithe
95204-complete.text:
<Oran bites the crest to ensure authenticity.>

Well I'll be. A genuine relic of our home. Mostly intact, too. We need to be extra careful with this one.

Thank you for your aid in restoring our history, $c. I'll see to it that we take good care of this.
95204-complete.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95204-progress.name: Oran Snakewrithe
95204-progress.text: What have you got there, $c? A tasty morsel?
95204-progress.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95212-accept.name: Rudra Amberstill
95212-accept.text:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
95212-accept.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95212-complete.name: Rudra Amberstill
95212-complete.text: These pelts will make excellent saddles. You've done the Alliance proud, $c!
95212-complete.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95212-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
95212-progress.text: You look chilly, $c. How goes the hunt?
95212-progress.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95213-accept.name: Unknown
95213-accept.text:
The keg is stamped:

BLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER

You get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.
95213-accept.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95213-complete.name: Quarrymaster Thesten
95213-complete.text:
<The dwarf turns pale as he sees the empty keg.>

...Where did you find this?
95213-complete.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95214-accept.name: Quarrymaster Thesten
95214-accept.text: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it.
95214-accept.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95214-progress.name: Quarrymaster Thesten
95214-progress.text: I hope you've got good news for me?
95214-progress.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95216-accept.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-accept.text:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
95216-accept.title: The New Plague

95216-complete.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-complete.text:
You killed it??

Hmmph. Lucky for you this should be enough ichor to reverse engineer its properties. You do not wish to be an enemy of the Royal Apothecary Society.

Get out of my sight!
95216-complete.title: The New Plague

95216-progress.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-progress.text:
Any fool can tell you the most potent transmission method will always be through the blood.

I must see this strain for myself!
95216-progress.title: The New Plague

95314-accept.name: Carolai Anise
95314-accept.text:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
95314-accept.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95349-accept.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
95349-accept.text:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive you upon your arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. Banu-Alah, $N.
95349-accept.title: The Earthen Ring

95349-complete.name: Alaana Stormwalker
95349-complete.text:
More adventurers from Zephras, I see. Wonderful. The winds surely favor us! It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore this new land.

Azeroth is an exciting new world, but it's also a dangerous world. You'd do well to prepare yourself for this new adventure by familiarizing yourself with the lands nearby.
95349-complete.title: The Earthen Ring

95350-accept.name: Alaana Stormwalker
95350-accept.text:
Its a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.

The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, $N.
95350-accept.title: Welcome to Azeroth

95350-complete.name: Thrall
95350-complete.text:
Lok-tar, $c. I am Thrall, Warchief of the Horde.

An Earthen Ring messenger told me to expect an emissary from the Windshapers, and here you are. I'd not have expected to see a high elf standing before me here in Orgrimmar, but the horde will welcome you as our guest all the same.

You have my blessing to travel through horde lands. Go with honor, Windshaper.
95350-complete.title: Welcome to Azeroth

955-progress.name: Asterion
955-progress.text: Once I have the earrings, I will cast the spell to search for the whereabouts of the seal that binds me. For centuries I have thought on the freedom destroying the seal would bring to me... Perhaps those centuries have taken a toll upon my mind that I might never recover...
955-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

956-progress.name: Asterion
956-progress.text:
The pillars of this shrine are as the bars of a prison to me, $N. No strength I still possess might break them, and no magic I wield might destroy them...

For a thousand years and more I have stared at them, wondering if at long last I outlived even the stone, would I be free? Or would it be invisible bars that held me then...
956-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

95774-accept.name: Mankrik
95774-accept.text:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
95774-accept.title: Her Name Is Olgra

958-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-progress.text: If only the tools of their undoing could have been destroyed in the cataclysm that destroyed our world... Nonetheless, we must do what we can to ensure that the horrors of our past are not repeated in the future.
958-progress.title: Tools of the Highborne

95803-accept.name: Danitha Morr
95803-accept.text:
Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.

Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.
95803-accept.title: A Token of Good Faith

959-accept.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-accept.text:
Oops!

Had a little mishap, as you can see! The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. That's when everything came tumbling down.

Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. No way I was going in there.

Maybe you're brave enough to find him?
959-accept.title: Trouble at the Docks

959-complete.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-complete.text:
Superb! And just as I was about to lose my job too! I will see to it that Gazlowe gets this gift immediately.

Thank you, $N. Nicely done, I say!
959-complete.title: Trouble at the Docks

959-progress.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-progress.text:
The dockmaster has been on my case ever since Mad Magglish made off with that 99-year-old port. I guess that bottle was intended as a gift for Gazlowe from none other than Baron Revilgaz himself.

If you're brave enough and patient enough to seek out Mad Magglish and get that port back, I'll see to it you get a nice reward.
959-progress.title: Trouble at the Docks

95981-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
95981-accept.text:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.
95981-accept.title: Watching the Roads

95998-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-accept.text:
Well howdy there, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

95998-complete.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
95998-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96055-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96055-accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
96055-accept.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

96056-complete.name: Balthus Stoneflayer
96056-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96056-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

96101-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
96101-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96101-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96101-complete.name: Raan Wildwind
96101-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96101-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96130-complete.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-complete.text: Taking the life of such a beautiful creature is a sad event, but it was necessary for the safety of our people. I will make certain that the pelt does not go to waste. Thank you.
96130-complete.title: Chakuyak

96130-progress.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-progress.text: Have you found the big wolf?
96130-progress.title: Chakuyak

962-accept.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-accept.text:
The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great Undercity of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, $N. Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the Forsaken.

Recently I studied a rare specimen of flora named Serpentbloom. I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential.

Unfortunately Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the Barrens.
962-accept.title: Serpentbloom

96204-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
96204-accept.text:
Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, $c.
96204-accept.title: The Windshaper's Wrath

96204-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
96204-complete.text:
Thank you again, $N. I've been aquatinting myself with Trevan here, who I've learned sent you along on my trail.

I've heard... less than charitable things about paladins thus far in my travels. As a sky-touched shen'dorei elf traveling through horde territory, I can certainly understand how easily intolerance and prejudice can take root. 

You and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.
96204-complete.title: The Windshaper's Wrath

963-progress.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-progress.text: With a great sorrow in my heart, I followed the Shan'do Stormrage into hibernation, and took my sorrow to my dreams, sleeping for the passing of thousands of years.
963-progress.title: For Love Eternal

96390-accept.name: Earthseer Farsen
96390-accept.text:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' not sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
96390-accept.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud

96390-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96390-complete.text:
These Dark Irons may be our cousins but they ain't family, that's for sure. I shed no tears for any misfortune that befalls them that stray too far from that accursed mountain o' theirs.

Hopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.
96390-complete.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud

96391-accept.name: Unknown
96391-accept.text:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.>
96391-accept.title: Underground Map

96391-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96391-complete.text:
Judging by this map, it certainly looks like these Dark Irons are planning some sort of incursion into the vaults beneath Ironforge. The band ye busted up to the east must be a scouting force.

Thank ye for bringing me this. If we hurry, we might be able to beat them to whatever their goal is down there.
96391-complete.title: Underground Map

96392-accept.name: Earthseer Farsen
96392-accept.text:
Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron $R problem.

If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
96392-accept.title: Farsen's Watch

96392-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96392-complete.text:
So ye see now, $c? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.

Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. Hows about a bit o' violence?
96392-complete.title: Farsen's Watch

96393-accept.name: Earthseer Farsen
96393-accept.text:
Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults. 

My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard. 

Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
96393-accept.title: Old Ironforge Incursion

96394-accept.name: Afadra Dunwall
96394-accept.text:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
96394-accept.title: The Restless Dead

96408-accept.name: Beldin Steelgrill
96408-accept.text:
Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking  the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.
96408-accept.title: A Visitor to Dun Morogh

966-progress.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-progress.text: Have you found any more of their scrolls? I should be able to piece together a larger picture of the cult if you can find them.
966-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

96604-accept.name: Brakk
96604-accept.text:

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96604-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96604-complete.name: Brakk
96604-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

96608-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96626-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96626-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96626-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96626-complete.name: Tomas
96626-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96626-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96627-accept.name: Marshal McBride
96627-accept.text:
$N, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.
96627-accept.title: The Adventurer

96627-complete.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96627-complete.text:
I appreciate the lookin' out, $c. That marshal's just a worrywart.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96627-complete.title: The Adventurer

96628-accept.name: Mountaineer Thalos
96628-accept.text:
Wait, $N. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.

My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
96628-accept.title: The Adventurer

96628-complete.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-complete.text:
You say these are from the mountaineers? Aye, I could use them. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96628-complete.title: The Adventurer

96628-progress.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96628-progress.title: The Adventurer

96638-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
96638-accept.text:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
96638-accept.title: The Adventurer

96652-accept.text:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96652-accept.title: The Adventurer

96652-complete.name: Brakk
96652-complete.text:
Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

96655-progress.name: Cook Torka
96655-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96655-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96656-accept.name: Executor Arren
96656-accept.text:
$N, you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.
96656-accept.title: The Adventurer

96656-complete.name: Eleanor Shackleton
96656-complete.text:
I'm not affiliated with the Scarlet Crusade, if you couldn't tell. I'm just an adventurer stopping by before my next venture into the wilderness.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96656-complete.title: The Adventurer

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96661-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96821-accept.name: Vel'rin Fang
96821-accept.text:
We be seein' fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I be hearin' there be spiders makin' their nest along the road.

If your travels be takin' you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
96821-accept.title: Legging It

96821-complete.name: Gar'Thok
96821-complete.text: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, $N. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.
96821-complete.title: Legging It

96822-accept.name: Turroc
96822-accept.text:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822-accept.title: For Honor

96822-complete.name: Turroc
96822-complete.text: These warriors will always be remembered, $N. You have made sure of that.
96822-complete.title: For Honor

96822-progress.name: Turroc
96822-progress.text: Have you done what I asked?
96822-progress.title: For Honor

96825-accept.name: Cook Torka
96825-accept.text:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
96825-accept.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

96825-complete.name: Cook Torka
96825-complete.text: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!
96825-complete.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

96875-accept.name: Kamari
96875-accept.text:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, $c. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!
96875-accept.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge

96876-accept.name: Unknown
96876-accept.text: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.
96876-accept.title: Ukor's Lost Pack

96876-complete.name: Ukor
96876-complete.text: My pack! When I dropped it to run from that huge spider, I thought I'd never see it again. You really are a hero!
96876-complete.title: Ukor's Lost Pack

96895-accept.name: Deathguard Terrence
96895-accept.text:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
96895-accept.title: The Argent Emissary

96895-complete.name: Hadric Harlson
96895-complete.text: Stay low and try not to be seen, $c. These cultists are not to be trifled with.
96895-complete.title: The Argent Emissary

96896-accept.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
96896-accept.text:
Danitha and I fought against the scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.

He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.

If only the rest of the forsaken felt the same way...
96896-accept.title: A Righteous Cause

96896-complete.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
96896-complete.text: I plan to stay here for a time and speak with more of my friends, but I will return to Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands soon enough. Should you ever find yourself out that way, please do say hello. We could always use more help from able-bodied adventurers.
96896-complete.title: A Righteous Cause

96897-accept.name: Hadric Harlson
96897-accept.text: The scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
96897-accept.title: The Cult of the Damned

96897-complete.name: Hadric Harlson
96897-complete.text: Thank you for your aid, $c. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.
96897-complete.title: The Cult of the Damned

96898-accept.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-accept.text:
It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal hanging beneath Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the scourge of them.
96898-accept.title: Remnants of War

96898-complete.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-complete.text: Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.
96898-complete.title: Remnants of War

96898-progress.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-progress.text: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
96898-progress.title: Remnants of War

96899-accept.name: Hadric Harlson
96899-accept.text:
You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.
96899-accept.title: Bandarion Keep

96899-complete.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
96899-complete.text:
This place is full of memories for me. This place was once held by the Argent Dawn. It was here from here that we prepared for many battles and skirmishes against the scourge during their most recent push into Tirisfal Glades.

When we withdrew to the Plaguelands I feared it would fall into disrepair. My fear was well-founded, but I am glad that Danitha and her paladins have taken over stewardship of it now.

She even named the keep after... a mutual friend.
96899-complete.title: Bandarion Keep

97003-accept.name: Gur'ak
97003-accept.text:
You there, $c. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, $c.
97003-accept.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97220-accept.name: Manifest Clerk Philmor
97220-accept.text:
Every day this week we've been short dockhands.

Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.
97220-accept.title: Philmor's Favor

97220-complete.name: Elaine Trias
97220-complete.text: Oh, dear. You think we want to carry that up the stairs ourselves? Keeping the valuables intact is your responsibility up until the point you drop it off.
97220-complete.title: Philmor's Favor

97220-progress.name: Elaine Trias
97220-progress.text: You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?
97220-progress.title: Philmor's Favor

97222-accept.name: Elaine Trias
97222-accept.text:
Yes, it's only a flight of stairs, but if it's such a small ask, it should be no problem for you to finish the delivery yourself! 

Trias' Cheese isn't part of the Gatehouse or their stocking inventory, but our buildings share a floor.

Place the crate outside their stockroom door--the guard will send someone for a regular pickup. They will see the package arrival and carry it inside as they return to post.
97222-accept.title: Gatehouse Goods

97222-complete.name: Elaine Trias
97222-complete.text:
Yep. There's a reason that hinge opens inwards towards them, so they don't get the door blocked by people leaving stuff anywhere they please.

Consider us professionally acquainted, $c. 

We respect your business, and expect you to respect ours.
97222-complete.title: Gatehouse Goods

97222-progress.name: Elaine Trias
97222-progress.text: You should at least try some of this aged cheddar. You can't stop eating it.
97222-progress.title: Gatehouse Goods

97223-accept.name: Xar'Ti
97223-accept.text:
All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
97223-accept.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97223-complete.name: Xar'Ti
97223-complete.text: Thank you, $N. I am happy we will be able to preserve her bloodline and raise them to be our allies. You have done a great service for our tribe.
97223-complete.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97223-progress.name: Xar'Ti
97223-progress.text:
The Bloodtalon are known for their cunning and swiftness, and make fine companions when raised from egg to adult.

Unfortunately adult raptors are very difficult to train, and I have tried to capture the Matriarch on more than one occasion. But she had become too dangerous of late.

Still I hope to preserve her legacy by raising her children as companions here in Sen'Jin.
97223-progress.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97225-accept.name: Master Vornal
97225-accept.text:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
97225-accept.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97225-complete.name: Master Gadrin
97225-complete.text:
You have done a great deed for our tribe today.

Unlike some tribes, our kinship with our loa is one of reverence and respect, and we owe them much.

I would not want the Darkspear to fall out of favor with them.
97225-complete.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97225-progress.name: Master Gadrin
97225-progress.text: Have you found our loa idols, $N? We must begin our rituals again soon.
97225-progress.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97246-accept.name: Thatog
97246-accept.text:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
97246-accept.title: Meal Appeal

97246-complete.name: Borstan
97246-complete.text:
Of course. Migi's parents and I have an arrangement to give Migi a bagged lunch every day, but I can only ensure the boy gets his food if he actually comes in to pick it up.

Sometimes, he doesn't pick up his meal multiple times a week, and I wonder where he gets the energy to stay out and play.
97246-complete.title: Meal Appeal

97249-accept.name: Borstan
97249-accept.text:
Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea. 

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily. 

Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
97249-accept.title: Favorite Food

97249-complete.name: Migi
97249-complete.text:
Borstan's Meats? Is that for one of us?

Oh!

Wow... this smells really good! Yummy.

Thanks for bringing me my lunch. I can tell what Borstan is going to be serving daily when my friends and I walk the road to Grommash Hold, by the smells alone. This tastes like my favorite, the sweetglaze! But it's different. I like the strong flavored crumbs.

If it's going to be this tasty every day, I think we need to stop our game to take our lunch together!
97249-complete.title: Favorite Food

97249-progress.name: Migi
97249-progress.text: I think we can win this one...
97249-progress.title: Favorite Food

97253-accept.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-accept.text:
Hey, got a sec?

So, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!

I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?
97253-accept.title: Parts and Pieces

97277-accept.name: Grund Drokda
97277-accept.text:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.

Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.

Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
97277-accept.title: Grund and Gozwin

97277-complete.name: Grund Drokda
97277-complete.text:
Aye, I'm not surprised to hear that snow leopard was makin' a meal of the boar we were fixin' fer roastin'!

Goz will have one less thing to stress about now that you brought back his log book. Maybe now he can focus all his energy on gettin' back on his feet.

Thanks, $N. Take a little something as a token of my appreciation, fer makin' the trek, and fer protectin' the hills.
97277-complete.title: Grund and Gozwin

97277-progress.name: Grund Drokda
97277-progress.text: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
97277-progress.title: Grund and Gozwin

97279-accept.name: Gornek
97279-accept.text:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
97279-accept.title: Wayward Weapons

97279-complete.name: Kzan Thornslash
97279-complete.text: Thank you for returning these weapons, $N. I will get to work repairing them for the next wave of recruits.
97279-complete.title: Wayward Weapons

97279-progress.name: Kzan Thornslash
97279-progress.text:
Throm'ka, $c. Gorak told me I should be expecting you. It is good to see you in one piece!

Were you able to collect the training weapons I requested?
97279-progress.title: Wayward Weapons

97286-complete.name: Garion Wendell
97286-complete.text: Your actions show you are one who respects knowledge. The library is open for use in your studies.
97286-complete.title: Research Access

97288-accept.name: Unknown
97288-accept.text:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>
97288-accept.title: Unending Torment

97288-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97288-complete.text:
Oho! I believe I know this head. A cruel joke by our Dark Lady. A delicious one at that.

I think I have a use for this.
97288-complete.title: Unending Torment

97289-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97289-accept.text:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching of this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
97289-accept.title: Unending Torment

97289-complete.name: Unfinished Abomination
97289-complete.text:
<The body twitches to life, panicking as it relives its final moments.>

You...
97289-complete.title: Unending Torment

97289-progress.name: Unfinished Abomination
97289-progress.text: <The abomination remains lifeless without a head to control it.>
97289-progress.title: Unending Torment

97290-accept.name: Unfinished Abomination
97290-accept.text:
You... abomination...

Why should... help you...

Be gone...
97290-accept.title: Unending Torment

97290-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97290-complete.text: Not cooperating, eh? Excellent. I always love a challenge.
97290-complete.title: Unending Torment

97291-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97291-accept.text:
With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.

We simply need to motivate it.

Fetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.

We have a potion to make!
97291-accept.title: Unending Torment

97291-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97291-complete.text: These will do nicely. We will see how much bravado our honored guest retains after he is subjected to my masterpiece.
97291-complete.title: Unending Torment

97291-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97291-progress.text: It will be ever so lovely to have our lost sheep returned to the fold, don't you think?
97291-progress.title: Unending Torment

97292-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97292-accept.text:
I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.

Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.

And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.
97292-accept.title: Unending Torment

97292-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97292-complete.text:
Excellent. We'll let his flesh simmer for awhile. Give him time to acclimate to his new home.

I have no further use for the wretch for now, but we shall keep an eye on him. I have many plans for Othmar's future.
97292-complete.title: Unending Torment

97292-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97292-progress.text:
For Othmar's crimes against the Dark Lady, placing him under that oozing specimen is the least he deserves.

And it's funny...
97292-progress.title: Unending Torment

97326-accept.name: Thra
97326-accept.text:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326-accept.title: Rocks to Rests

97485-accept.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-accept.text:
Blessings of An'she, child.

We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485-accept.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97558-accept.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-accept.text:
One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?

Well, it doesn't.

Ours is a cursed life, $N. We must take from the living to further our own existence.

When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!

Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
97558-accept.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97558-complete.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-complete.text: Ah, excellent! Thank you for acquiring these. I can promise they will be put to good use.
97558-complete.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97558-progress.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-progress.text:
Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.

It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.

Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.
97558-progress.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97891-accept.name: Alessandro Luca
97891-accept.text:
You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!

It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.

Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.

But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>
97891-accept.title: Prompt Potion Runner

97891-complete.name: Doctor Martin Felben
97891-complete.text:
Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time!

Here, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me?

If not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.
97891-complete.title: Prompt Potion Runner

97899-accept.name: Brakk
97899-accept.text:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
97899-accept.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

97903-accept.name: Brakk
97903-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97903-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97903-complete.name: Rawrk
97903-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97903-complete.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97904-accept.name: Brakk
97904-accept.text:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97904-accept.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97905-accept.name: Brakk
97905-accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97905-accept.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97907-accept.name: Brakk
97907-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97907-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

97914-complete.name: Baros Alexston
97914-complete.text: <Baros opens the letter and begins to read it, his smile fading.>
97914-complete.title: Expanding Horizons

97914-progress.name: Baros Alexston
97914-progress.text:
I can smell the sea on you, friend!

<Baros laughs.>

What brings you to Stormwind?
97914-progress.title: Expanding Horizons

97916-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97916-accept.text:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97916-accept.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97916-complete.name: Smith Argus
97916-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Sharpening Wheel. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97916-complete.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97919-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97919-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97919-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97919-complete.name: Michelle Belle
97919-complete.text:

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97920-complete.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97921-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97921-accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97921-accept.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97923-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97923-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97923-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

97923-complete.name: Gelman Stonehand
97923-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97923-complete.title: Camping 101: Mining

97924-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97924-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97924-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97924-complete.name: Helene Peltskinner
97924-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97924-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97926-accept.name: Baros Alexston
97926-accept.text:
I wish it was that easy to help, $c. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
97926-accept.title: Making Do

97926-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
97926-complete.text:
Sad news indeed. Still, I thank you for making the journey.

With neither Stormwind nor Darnassus coming to aid us, it seems that Auberdine's fate is our own to decide.
97926-complete.title: Making Do

97926-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
97926-progress.text: You have returned. What news comes from Stormwind?
97926-progress.title: Making Do

97953-complete.name: Vance Undergloom
97953-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97953-complete.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97955-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
97955-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97955-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97955-complete.text:

97965-complete.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97967-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97967-accept.text:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97967-accept.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97969-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97969-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97969-accept.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97969-complete.name: Indari Sunseam
97969-complete.text:
There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
